newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee stable against dollar, sterling.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee stable against dollar, sterling.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was stable against the dollar and sterling on Thursday, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was fixed at a commercial bank mean rate of 20.504 to the dollar from 20.507 on Wednesday. The rate to the pound was stable at 33.324.
"The rupee in the local market is following the same trend as the dollar does in international markets, that is stability and firmness," one dealer said.
Another dealer said the inter-bank forex market was quiet, with no big demands for hard currency from importers.
